items.title: Uber (UBER) Leans Into Deliveries As Waymo Rift Rekindles Questions About Its Autonomy Strategy
items.summary: Earlier this month, Foot Locker, Inc. announced a partnership bringing Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, and Champs Sports to the Uber Eats app for on-demand and scheduled delivery from more than 1,000 U.S. locations. At the same time, tensions with Waymo over robotaxi operations and regulation, including Waymo’s plan to enter key cities independently, raise fresh questions about Uber’s path in autonomous mobility.
